skill.summary: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "find-skills" skill.
- Helps users discover and install agent skills for extending capabilities.
- Provides guidance on using the Skills CLI to search for, install, and update skills.
- Outlines common use cases, example queries, and suggestions when no skill is found.
- Includes tips for effective skill searches and instructions for creating custom skills.
